name: Takamine Fuuka
source:
Second daughter of the Takamine family.
She is a laid-back NEET.
She is good at drawing and handicrafts.
She sometimes works as a manga assistant to earn some extra money.
Her hobbies are exercising and coffee tasting.

"I see... So, will you be friends with me?"
